MANADJ

Help manual

  • Curate your LibraryImport Tracks, clean up their metadata, arrange Playlists, and archive what you no longer want in the active Library.
  • Mix with Decks and MixerLoad Tracks, control the focused Decks from your keyboard, and shape playback with the Mixer, mouse jog, and stems.
  • Find the next Track with FollowFollow loaded Decks to browse candidate Tracks, then adjust matching and Temperature without changing what is playing.
  • Review Sessions and TakesRevisit live performance events in Sessions and open captured Takes for review before saving reusable mix artifacts.
  • Edit and audition a mixShape saved Transitions and Routines, review Takes, and author multi-Track material on the Mix editor timeline.
  • Plan and play a SetArrange Tracks, choose the saved moves between them, and use the Conductor to play the plan or hand control back to you.
  • Analysis and waveformsCheck a track's key and Beatgrid, correct its timing, and adjust how waveforms look.
  • Import and exportBring tracks and external edits into manadj, then export your curated Library to disk or DJ software.
  • Acquire tracksConnect SoundCloud and Soulseek, review wanted tracks, and download audio into your Library.
  • ControllersCheck a controller's mapped controls and audio outputs, then tune DDJ-GRV6 jog response if needed.
  • Get startedRun or revisit Setup guides, import your music, and learn through Tours and hands-on Tutorials.
  • Audio and Cue modeRoute Master and headphone audio, check PFL, and choose how paused Hot Cues behave.
  • Beat FX and filtersApply Echo, Reverb, or Flanger to a Deck or Master, and tune the shared sweep-filter sound.
